The evidence explicitly states in Section 3.1 that 'Degenerated situations may occur in the ray casting methods, when a ray hits an edge or a vertex.' Finally, it confirms that 'VF-Ray can handle these two situations by using the Use_set data structure,' implying the algorithm was developed to address these specific limitations of previous approaches like Bunyk's.
